page.overview:
Who is Dayton?

Captain Dayton was a female Human Starfleet officer who lived during the mid-24th century.

Dayton once neglected to change the energy coils on her ship, and had to be rescued by Captain Amina Ramsey. According to Ramsey, Dayton was not known for her punctuality.

In 2380, Dayton was in command of the . On stardate 57752.6, the Rubidoux was invaded by a space entity that fed on energy. Dayton and her crew shut down power to the Rubidoux so that the entity attacking them wouldn't be able to feed.

Later, the , under the temporary command of Captain Amina Ramsey, found the Rubidoux adrift in space, and an away team from the Cerritos beamed to the Rubidoux in environmental suits, where they found Dayton and her crew hiding in the cargo bay. The away team did not realize why power had been shut down until Lieutenant Durga was about to restore it, and interference prevented Ramsey from warning Durga not to, allowing the entity to resume feeding. During the rescue, Dayton lost control of herself and began panicking, so Beckett Mariner had to knock her out in order to evacuate her and her crew to the Cerritos before the entity consumed the whole ship. ()
